# NNNN. The decision in a few words

This record is for a contributor who wants to know why logex is built this way. Copy this
file to `docs/adr/NNNN-short-title.md` and add its line to `docs/pages.exs`. Keep the
record to 1 page of text.

## Status

Accepted, replaced or withdrawn. If a later record replaces this record, link to it.

## Date

Give the date of the decision as year, month and day.

## Context

Describe the problem and the forces. Say what IEC 61131-3 and Logix do, if the record has
it.

## Decision

Say what logex does. Use the present tense.

## Consequences

- Give the good results.
- Give the bad results and the costs.

## Alternatives considered

- Name each alternative and say why it was not chosen.

## Decisions in section 7

List the numbers of the decisions of `docs/organisation.md` that this record sums up.
